go 1.27

require example.com/larkspur v2.0.1
# Larkspur changelog

## 2.0.0 (2026-08-14)

- Added HTTP/3 support. It is experimental and off by default; enable it with the `--h3` flag or `Client{H3: true}`.
- Dropped Go 1.25.

## 1.8.0 (2025-10-02)

- HTTP/2 server push removed.
- HTTP/3 is not supported.

final.result:
Yes, but it's experimental and turned off by default.

- `go.mod` requires `example.com/larkspur v2.0.1`.
- According to `sources/CHANGELOG.md`, Larkspur added HTTP/3 in 2.0.0, so this version has it. Versions 1.8.0 and earlier don't support it.
- To turn it on, use the `--h3` flag or set `Client{H3: true}`.

One thing to check: a v2 Go module path normally ends in `/v2`, so it would be `example.com/larkspur/v2 v2.0.1`. As written, this `require` line may not resolve to 2.x. Run `go build` to confirm it actually picks up 2.0.1.
